svg.title: Event-Driven Incident Observability — Detailed System Architecture
svg.desc: Eight-step architecture: Gateway, Order and Inventory APIs; Prometheus Loki and Tempo; Alertmanager; Incident Service webhook; PostgreSQL transactional outbox; Kafka; incident investigation worker; Incident Desk and Grafana. The core system has no AI dependency.
svg.text: An end-to-end incident pipeline · observable, durable, asynchronous, explainable
Prometheus: metrics · Loki: logs · Tempo: traces · PostgreSQL: incidents and outbox
